feeds.title: Galería Duque Arango Blog
feeds.description: Since its inception in 1980, Duque Arango has stood as a beacon of art dissemination, showcasing established and emerging artists, offering investment advice to national and international collectors. Galeria Duque Arango, renowned for its presentation of modern and contemporary art, serves as a platform for exploring diverse works through insightful articles. Delve into the world of art investment and discovery with Galería Duque Arango's curated offerings, setting the stage for artistic exploration and investment enlightenment.

feeds.title: Bitácora Almendrón Blog
feeds.description: Bitacora Almendron, affiliated with the non-profit Cultural Association 'Almendrón,' serves as a virtual gateway to the realms of art, culture, and politics. Integral to their educational and research endeavour, it curates a diverse array of content online, bridging the worlds of culture, art, and science. As a curated space, it offers a panoramic vista of human expression and knowledge, enriching audiences with interconnected facets of the human experience.

feeds.title: Osa Menor. Arts Education for Children and Youth
feeds.description: Jorge Raedó, born in Zaragoza in 1969, is an artist and professor specializing in art education for children and youth. Since 2008, his work 'Osa Menor' has been a focal point in his research and practice. His site features his work, painting, portfolio, the meaning behind his work, other artists, feature stories and more.

feeds.title: Museo De Antioquia
feeds.description: The Museum of Antioquia in Medellín, Colombia, invites exploration with its 141-year legacy as the region's inaugural museum. Boasting an exceptional collection of contemporary art, it showcases captivating permanent and temporary exhibitions. The institution, deeply intertwined with the community, prioritizes education and culture, fostering meaningful engagement and collaboration. This venerable museum stands as a cultural beacon, bridging the past and present for enriching artistic experiences.

feeds.title: Libros y Letras
feeds.description: Founded on July 1, 2003, Libros y Letras emerged as a non-profit cultural Foundation committed to nurturing, promoting, and disseminating cultural and literary expressions from Colombia and Latin America. Its steadfast priority lies in fostering the development of cultural discourse, reaching audiences through various media platforms, including radio and television programs. Libros y Letras remains dedicated to enriching the cultural landscape, serving as a conduit for the vibrant voices of the region.

feeds.title: Telemedellín » Cultura
feeds.description: Telemedellín's production prowess is delivered through its cutting-edge digital mobile unit, equipped with three Sony DXC D50 digital cameras, a 12-input Grass Valley indigo switcher, a 32-channel sound console, and versatile recording capabilities. With two 30-kilowatt power plants, a hybrid telephone system, a microwave unit, and more, it ensures a technologically advanced and versatile production environment.

feeds.title: Arte Contemporáneo Blog
feeds.description: Contemporary Art, a digital hub pulsating with modern artistic fervour, fosters a dynamic space for the promotion and exchange of captivating artworks. Its specialized blog delves deep into diverse topics, unravelling artistic trends and sparking nuanced discussions that enrich the contemporary art landscape. Here, enthusiasts, collectors, and artists converge, exploring and acquiring pieces that redefine the boundaries of creativity, making it a curated haven for those passionate about the evolving realm of artistic expression.

feeds.title: Teleantioquia » Culture
feeds.description: Teleantioquia emerges as a multifaceted platform, offering a diverse array of content spanning news, articles, editorial boards, and more. With a comprehensive approach, it delves into national affairs, sports, culture, economy, emissions, and entrepreneurship, captivating audiences with engaging and informative discourse. Serving as a beacon of information and entertainment, Teleantioquia enriches the lives of its viewers by providing a rich tapestry of content reflective of the region's vibrant dynamism.

feeds.title: Arte Universidad de los Andes
feeds.description: The Art Department at Universidad de los Andes - Colombia fosters a vibrant atmosphere for creative inquiry and academic endeavours, regularly disseminating news and updates. As a beacon of dynamic exploration, it cultivates a rich environment where creativity thrives. Stay informed and inspired by the latest developments from the esteemed Art Department, as it paves the way for innovative artistic discourse and scholarly pursuits.

feeds.title: Eluniversal Blog » Cultural
feeds.description: El Universal, the digital platform for El Universal Cartagena, epitomizes the essence of daily news coverage. With a steadfast commitment to journalistic integrity, it serves as the quintessential source for news, politics, sports, and beyond. El Universal Cartagena's comprehensive coverage encapsulates the pulse of the city, offering readers a nuanced understanding of local and global affairs, and fostering informed discourse and community engagement.

feeds.title: Escuela Nueva Cultura Blog
feeds.description: For over three decades, Escuela Nueva Cultura has been a beacon of success in nurturing musical talent among children and young individuals. With its pioneering approach to musical pedagogy, it has consistently delivered outstanding results, enriching the lives of countless youths. Escuela Nueva Cultura's dedication to musical education continues to shape the aspirations and achievements of its students, fostering a legacy of excellence in the realm of music.
